properties.name: Sítio Catarinense Plot 1 (INCRA property)
properties.notes: Boundary = closed 5-vertex KML supplied by Jhordan (00000057-sitio catarinense.kml), shoelace area 150.78 ha on an equirectangular projection vs 150 ha claimed via INCRA settlement - consistent. Perimeter 5.85 km, simple polygon (no self-intersection). Four corner coordinates Jhordan separately typed in chat (DMS) match 4 of the 5 KML vertices, so the KML is consistent with his own numbers rather than a redraw. boundary_authority=approx: hand-typed corners + a hand-drawn KML, NOT a GPS walk nor a CAR/INCRA polygon - an authoritative INCRA polygon likely exists and would upgrade this. No overlap with any registered SunMint plot (nearest V-06-29, ~33 km). Property: family on land since 2014, father acquired 150 ha via INCRA settlement; region since 2008. Cacao, cassava, corn, cattle, plus dozens of protected giant Bertholletia excelsa (est. 300-400 yr). Existing CFR Anapu tree record pk-qkejKJJW3IAD (92 unique trees, R$520, already paid) sits on this land and is to be linked to this plot. plot_type intentionally left blank: cacao + cattle + standing forest mix has NOT been classified by the governor.
